key_requirements: Incorporates GDPR via EEA Agreement, consent age 13, sensitive data rules
deceased_data: Not covered: no specific rules on deceased persons' data (government reply to ESA, 2019)
research_exemption: Archiving, scientific/historical research and statistics without consent where public interest clearly outweighs harm, after consulting DPO; right of access may be restricted (section numbers not confirmed)
genetic_data: Special category under art. 9 GDPR; no specific rules beyond GDPR; Datatilsynet guideline on genetic and biometric data
notes: Act of 15 June 2018 no. 38; replaced 2000 Act; in force with EEA Decision 154/2018
